headline: Gold Slides Toward $4,000 as Fed Holds Policy Rates With Muted Guidance
summary: Spot gold declined 0.9% to $4,030.94 an ounce in Asian trading after the US Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged without offering clear guidance on upcoming cuts.
why: Gold prices are sensitive to US real interest rates and dollar strength, serving as a primary safe-haven and inflation-hedging asset.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold slipped 0.9% as benchmark interest rates remained on hold without dovish signals.

why_moved: Gold dropped 0.9% to $4,030.94 after the Federal Reserve held rates steady and offered limited guidance on future easing.
